title: The AI-First CFO: From Steward to Strategist
creator: Dr. Debasis Pahi
tagline: Preparing Business Students for the AI-Powered Economy
description: Daily pack on how AI-first CFOs achieve 23% higher revenue growth while most finance organizations remain far from transformation-ready. Based on IBM 2026 CFO Study, Deloitte, and McKinsey findings.
philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
key_facts: IBM 2026 CFO Study (1,500 CFOs): AI-first CFOs associated with 23% higher revenue growth 2022-2024
Only 6% of finance organizations are transformation-ready
Deloitte: 54% of finance leaders lead AI capital allocation; 60% expect AI costs to rise through 2027
McKinsey: ~90% use AI; only 37% report positive EBIT contribution
